# Prescriptive lessons — dirk-laukens × jazz-guitar-patterns-vol-1

53 notes across 9 chord_qualities. Key vocabulary: upper-structure-substitution-lattice, bebop-scale-family, approach-and-enclosure-vocabulary. Patterns-vol-1 is dense with substitution arpeggio rules (relative-major over min7, half-dim from 3rd of dom7, diminished from b9, Wes Montgomery minor-triad-on-5th, augmented arpeggio extraction from altered scale).

See prescriptive-lessons-draft.json for the structured payload covering: maj7, min7, dom7, dom7b9, dom7alt, min7b5, dim7, sus4, aug7. Compact form to keep PR review surface manageable.
